task.description: Hard-gate CODE-DESIGNER's design in lib/letflow/design/iss0414-service-catalog-safety-net.md against ISS-0414's five acceptance criteria before ELIXIR-DEV implements.
acceptance_criteria: Mechanism placement is justified against both options ISS-0414 names (test_helper.exs vs. mix letflow.check.test) and against the existing TenantSchemaReaper convention, with evidence read from the actual files, not assumed
Design specifies the exact mechanism: where it runs, what it does on finding unexpected rows (warn/auto-clean/fail), and the precise algorithm

Design addresses whether service_catalog has any legitimate non-test use that the mechanism must not disturb (checked: none in the test DB; dev/prod use via the admin API is real but structurally unreachable by this mechanism per its test_helper.exs placement)
Design addresses avoiding new flakiness, specifically race conditions against scripts/test_parallel.sh's partitioning

result.summary: Independently re-verified every load-bearing claim in lib/letflow/design/iss0414-service-catalog-safety-net.md rather than trusting CODE-DESIGNER's summary. (1) Read test/support/tenant_schema_reaper.ex in full: the pg_stat_activity-based concurrent-invocation guard (current_application_name/1, concurrent_invocation_present?/2, group_tag_of/1, lines 179-222) exists exactly as described, is private, and the design's plan to add a new public function on the SAME module reusing these helpers verbatim (same-module call, no duplication) is accurate and correctly justified over a new sibling module. (2) `grep -rln "setup_all" test/ | xargs grep -l "ServiceCatalog\|service_catalog"` returns empty -- confirmed no setup_all usage against this table. (3) `grep -rn "service_catalog\|ServiceCatalog" lib/mix/tasks/letflow.seed.ex priv/repo/seeds.exs` returns empty -- never seeded; independently grepped all three real ServiceCatalog-touching test files (service_catalog_test.exs, admin_services_test.exs, service_scope_validator_test.exs) and confirmed each uses per-test setup/on_exit cleanup only, no setup_all, no persistent fixture -- table's correct boundary content is genuinely always empty. (4) Confirmed via mix.exs (elixirc_paths(:test) includes test/support) and mix test's own MIX_ENV=test hardcoding that test/test_helper.exs structurally cannot load config/dev.exs or config/prod.exs -- dev/prod unreachability holds. (5) Read scripts/test_parallel.sh in full and traced the TEST_PARALLEL_GROUP="tp$$" export/config/test.exs application_name-suffix/group_tag_of matching chain end to end -- sibling partitions genuinely share one group tag and are excluded from triggering deferral, while a truly separate concurrent invocation carries no matching group and still defers; this is real structural behavior, not merely asserted. (6) Applied the no-silent-deferral standard to both open questions: OQ-1 (same-invocation mid-run leaks) is a genuine structural limit of any suite-boundary-only sweep, identical in shape to the precedent's own unresolved OQ-1 -- legitimately deferrable, not a gap resolvable from material already read. OQ-2 (reaper renaming) is a cosmetic judgment call explicitly and reasonably left to REVIEWER, not a defect. Both are honest deferrals, not evasions. (7) Grepped the design doc for defmodule/defstruct/def -- zero matches; exactly one bare @spec line (line 237), no function bodies. All five acceptance criteria independently confirmed met with evidence, not assumption. No defect found.
result.routing: Route to Step 2 ELIXIR-DEV to implement per lib/letflow/design/iss0414-service-catalog-safety-net.md.
